name: Omega-3 EPA
summary: High-dose EPA significantly reduces major cardiovascular events.
description: High-dose EPA has strong cardiovascular outcome support, with anti-inflammatory lipid signaling effects that can reduce atherothrombotic risk.
safetyNotes: Mild gastrointestinal effects may occur. Higher-dose, long-term marine omega-3 trials show an atrial-fibrillation signal; clinically significant bleeding is not established at common studied doses.
evidenceLevel: Editorial grade not demonstrated by recorded studies
